name: Mantel Clock
summary: Mantel or desk clock with a round face on an arched wooden case; anim tick moves the hands. For bedrooms and studies.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the plinth stands on y; set y to a shelf or desk top to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 400 px tall); use about 0.3–0.5 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: tick = second hand jumps once a second and the hands turn

author: krakujs
